title: Neutrophil percentage to albumin ratio and advanced cardiovascular-kidney-metabolic syndrome in diabetes: a machine learning approach.
summary: NHANES data from 9,375 adults were analyzed for NPAR/advanced CKM association; Boruta-based feature selection and an ML model predicted advanced CKM (validation AUC 0.872), a retrospective association/prediction result.
